price_basis: average posted net price, last 4 weeks of the period
rush_hour_note: Rush hour, weekdays 6 to 9 am and 4 to 7 pm: detour minutes count 1.17 times (Tucson Travel Time Index, Texas A&M 2025 Urban Mobility Report).
ranking_note: Stops before the last delivery are ranked lower to protect the delivery schedule.

worked_example.price_basis: median Tucson posted price, Oct 4 to Oct 31, 2026
worked_example.sentence: For a 72-gallon fill at $6.614 a gallon (median Tucson posted price, Oct 4 to Oct 31, 2026), a 12-minute detour at 7 am costs $14.30 ($8.89 driver time, $4.41 fuel, $1.00 wear), so the station needs to be at least 19.9 cents a gallon cheaper to pay off.
